wbg_operations.title: Health Emergency Preparedness, Response and Resilience Program Using the Multiphase Programmatic Approach
wbg_operations.amount_basis: World Bank original commitment (USD), whole operation; not allocated to clusters
wbg_operations.description: The development objective of the Health Emergency Preparedness, Response, and Resilience Program Using the Multiphase Programmatic Approach (MPA) Project is to strengthen health system resilience and multisectoral preparedness and response to health emergencies in Eastern and Southern Africa. There are four components to the project, the first component being strengthening the preparedness and resilience of regional and national health systems to manage health emergencies. This component will finance capacity strengthening of essential institutions, and activities that directly contribute to the resilience of the health systems to cope with HEs and are complementary to other health systems strengthening (HSS). This will have four subcomponents: (i) multisectoral and cross-border planning, financing, and governance; (ii) health workforce development, including a focus on identifying and addressing gender gaps in career progression; (iii)  access to quality health commodities, including building capacity for local vaccine and pharmaceutical manufacturing, based on the lessons learned from the challenges in accessing COVID-19 vaccines in the region; and (iv) information systems for HEs and the digitalization. The second component is the improving the detection of and response to HEs through a multisectoral approach. the third component is the program management. The component will finance expenditures related to M&E, the program leaning agenda including building a body of evidence on gender in PPR, and program implementation and coordination. Finally, the fourth component is the contingent emergency response component. This component will facilitate access to rapid financing by allowing for the reallocation of uncommitted project funds in the event of a natural disaster in a country, either by a formal declaration of a national emergency or upon a formal request from the government.
iati_titles: Health Emergency Preparedness, Response and Resilience Program Using the Multiphase Programmatic Approach

wbg_operations.title: Regional Climate Resilience Program for Eastern and Southern Africa 1 Project (RCRP1)
wbg_operations.amount_basis: World Bank original commitment (USD), whole operation; not allocated to clusters
wbg_operations.sector: FY17 - Agriculture, Fishing and Forestry,FY17 - Public Administration,FY17 - Social Protection,FY17 - Water, Sanitation and Waste Management
wbg_operations.description: The objective of the Regional Climate Resilience Program for Eastern and Southern Africa Project is to improve the management of water-related climate impacts in Eastern and Southern Africa, and, in case of an Eligible Crisis or Emergency, to respond promptly and effectively to it. There are five components to the project, the first component being risk management and climate financing. This component includes two subcomponents: climate and disasters risk management, and climate financing. the second component is the infrastructure investments and sustainable asset management for climate resilience. This component includes three subcomponents: enhancing institutional capacity for long-term climate risk management, closing the climate resilient infrastructure gap, and sustainable asset management. The third component is the adaptive climate services for resilient communities. This component includes two subcomponents: empowering communities to manage climate risk, and mainstreaming climate resilience in social protection programs. The fourth component is the project management. Finally, the fifth component is the contingent emergency response component.
iati_titles: Regional Climate Resilience Program for Eastern and Southern Africa 1 Project (RCRP1)
